content.tagline: Korean skincare: from pigmentation to firmness, hydration and pores
content.descriptor: Korean skincare brand RAVIEL; OEM/ODM through certified partners
about: PINE WORLD is the owner and developer of the Korean skincare brand RAVIEL. The product lines are built around specific skin concerns: pigmentation and tone evening (brightening), firmness, hydration and pore care. The company positions itself as a brand owner, developer and trading-and-distribution operator, not as an in-house manufacturing factory.

The RAVIEL brand is built around its own SILK (Skin-Ingredient Link Key) active-delivery concept — a proprietary approach to how an active ingredient is retained and works in the skin. On this foundation sit the specialized lines: Acerola, Bakuchiol Mela Free, Biome 8X Hyaluronic and Retinol 10X Peptide, along with base products.

In addition to its own brand, PINE WORLD offers direct OEM/ODM — development and manufacturing under the customer's brand through certified Korean manufacturing partners. RAVIEL products are present in Korean retail, the pharmacy and duty-free channels, and on international online marketplaces.

lines.name: Acerola
lines.note: Pigmentation care and tone evening (brightening — cosmetically): a cream, an ampoule and a toner with acerola extract, niacinamide and houttuynia extract.

lines.name: Bakuchiol Mela Free
lines.note: Firmness and tone care with bakuchiol — a plant-based cosmetic alternative to retinol: a cream and a serum, a slow-aging direction.

lines.name: Biome 8X Hyaluronic
lines.note: Hydration and care for pores and oily skin: a cream and an ampoule with a complex of eight hyaluronic acids, ceramides and a probiotic complex.

lines.name: Retinol 10X Peptide
lines.note: Skin texture and firmness care: an ampoule with retinol and a peptide complex, a slow-aging direction.

lines.name: Base products
lines.note: Targeted and vitamin care: a multivitamin serum for tone and a panthenol spot cream for localized pigmentation care.

tech.name: Skincare specialization
tech.note: Specialized lines for specific concerns — pigmentation, firmness, hydration, pores — based on the proprietary SILK active-delivery concept. The company provides clinical and marketing materials after a contract; they are not reproduced on the site as independently verified.

tech.name: OEM/ODM through partners
tech.note: Direct OEM/ODM — development and manufacturing under the customer's brand through certified Korean manufacturing partners. An in-house factory is not claimed as a fact.

tech.name: Registrations and standards
tech.note: Per company data — EU CPNP and US MoCRA registration references, manufacturing at cGMP-standard facilities, as well as vegan and EWG claims. This is company data and registration references, not regulatory approval; copies of supporting documents are provided at the deal stage.

content.exportNote: RAVIEL brand products are present in Korean retail (including Olive Young), in the pharmacy channel and duty-free, as well as on international online marketplaces; per company data, exports cover markets in Asia, North America and Europe. For open directions, including Latin and North America, materials are published through Teranova.

terms.label: Cooperation formats
terms.value: Wholesale supply of finished RAVIEL brand products; OEM/ODM — development and manufacturing under the customer's brand through certified Korean manufacturing partners.

terms.label: Minimum order
terms.value: Per the current price list — from one box per SKU (roughly 54–150 units for the main full-size items; certain items have different batches); orders below a box carry a surcharge. The exact MOQ is confirmed at the deal stage.

terms.label: Prices
terms.value: FOB Korea, on request / to be confirmed. Offer validity — 60 days. Prepayment: orders up to 10,000 USD — 100%, from 10,000 USD — 70% advance and 30% before shipment; EXW is discussed for larger orders.

terms.label: Lead times
terms.value: From stock — immediate shipment possible; manufacturing — roughly 45 days. Delivery terms depend on the destination country and shipping method; samples are discussed separately.

terms.label: How it works
terms.value: Request → Teranova review and alignment → negotiations and samples → logistics, customs and payment, turnkey.

content.consentNote: The data and materials are provided by PINE WORLD CO., LTD. (RAVIEL brand) and published with its written consent dated 31.07.2026. The manufacturer's direct contacts are not disclosed. Teranova coordinates and supports the deal.
